### Five Tips for When You’re Tired of Waiting
Author: Kelly Balarie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-october-24-2018.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 11:12
Points:
- Unresolved waiting periods often stir up old insecurities, fear of failure, and feelings of abandonment.
- Scriptural examples show that times of waiting are normal and purposeful rather than punitive.
- Entering new spiritual terrain requires preparation that God develops during periods of waiting.
- Believers can wait constructively by standing firm in Christ's sacrifice and their identity as God's children.
- Treating waiting seasons as faith-building opportunities helps people notice daily blessings and grow.

### Streams in the Desert - January 1
Author: L. B. Cowman (Streams in the Desert)
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/desert/streams-in-the-desert-january-1st.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 11:11-12
Points:
- Entering an unknown season brings the comforting assurance that God constantly watches over His people.
- Believers depend directly on heaven's supply, drawing from divine resources that never run dry.
- The rugged hills and trials of life serve a purpose by catching the rain that waters fruitful valleys.
- Difficult circumstances provide spiritual shelter and protect believers from greater dangers.
- Believers can step forward into the future trusting the Father's loving guidance through every loss and sorrow.
